scientific_integrity: The result is a mathematically reconstructed same-model result; no independent validation has been performed. The stability-bound formula is acknowledged as algebraically known for a different stochastic lag model, not claimed to be new.
scientific_limitations: Only iid unrescaled Bernoulli deliveries of fixed one-step-stale scalar quadratic gradients and constant positive gain. The uniqueness and strict monotonicity pertain to asymptotic expected-square rate, not finite-horizon or pathwise optimality; related random-control priority is incompletely accessible.
title: A unique rate-optimal gain for packet-erased one-step-delayed gradient descent
